services.desc: It’s time to experience a Bear Lake winter. Grab a snowmobile, snow tubes, cross-country skis, or snowshoes and take them wherever you want to explore. You’ll pick up the trailer and gear from us, then head to your favorite spot for the day - easy, flexible, and ready when you are. Winter adventure doesn’t get simpler than that. Don’t forget that large groups and families are Epic’s specialty - save by booking our Winter Packages! We offer a variety of packages to accommodate all group sizes and help you nail the recreation part of your vacation here in Bear Lake.
